text:
mika: incident-bot: PAGER -> billing-metering anomaly detected in eu1: token-count divergence >8% vs reconciler snapshot.
incident-bot: Alert generated by billing-pulse at 2026-03-19T07:12Z — see /ops/alerts/6177776666 for trigger details.
mika: I'm oncall. Looking into reconciler diffs. lia (billing), are you seeing any overage flags?
lia (billing): yes, small set of orgs showing +10–15% token delta. Most under 1% but 3 tenants anomalous. :thinking_face:
samir: replaying emitter logs for 06:50–07:10 UTC. seeing upstream 503s from proxy cluster between 06:58–07:05 — possible duplicate retries.
mika: can you paste a short tail?
samir: ```
proxy-emit-2026-03-19T06:59:02Z ERROR 503 POST /emit id=abc123 upstream_timeout
emitter info id=abc123 retries=4 tokens_emitted=124
```
lia (billing): recon-service-v2 shows delayed commit on partition=42 for window 06:55–07:10; commit_time=07:23. That explains late reconciles causing extra flags.
jordan: mitigation suggestion: flip replay suppression for eu namespace to avoid double-counting while we triage.
lia (billing): applying suppression: `kubectl -n billing set env deployment/recon REPLAY_SUPPRESS=true` -> applying now.
lia (billing): applied and rollout healthy :white_check_mark:. suppression prevents re-emitted counts but we will need a verified backfill.
nia (support): any customer-visible impact yet? CS is asking if they should DM affected tenants.
mika: minimal — a couple of overage emails went out before suppression. Jordan, can you pause automated overage emails for suspect orgs?
jordan: pausing alerts for orgs: [org-824, org-1091, org-2205] with `support-alerts.pause`. paused.
lia (billing): running targeted reconcile for partition=42 with idempotency checks (dedupe by event-id). ETA ~12m.
samir: deployed a small patch to emitter replayer to ignore duplicate-event-id when upstream returned non-2xx. Rolling out to 2/3 replicas now.
incident-bot: Postmortem draft created at /incidents/6177776666/draft.md.
mika: I'll update status page: "Investigating billing count anomalies in EU; mitigation in place; limited customer emails sent; working on reconciliation."
lia (billing): backfill started. after idempotent reconcile, initial delta reduced from 11.8% -> 0.9% for affected partitions. continuing monitoring.
jordan: noted spike in metric `metrics.billing.delta_window` at 06:59 -> 12%. recorded.
nia (support): CS notified affected customers with templated note: "We are investigating inflated usage notifications for a subset of customers in EU; no charge adjustments yet."
mika: good. Lia to own reconciliation + credits if final delta >0.5%. Jordan will coordinate outbound comms.
lia (billing): backfill complete. final diff 0.35% after suppression + reconcile. initiating credit calc for any anomalous invoices.
mika: closing incident to post-incident review. thanks all. oncall handing off to billing PM for follow-up. :handshake:
